title: What Is an AI Agent? (and why data engineers build them)

music.prompt: modern minimal electronic, curious and confident, steady light beat, no vocals

shots.say: An AI agent is a program that can plan steps and use tools to finish a task,
In this video I am going to show you how an AI agent works, and why data engineers are needed to build AI agents.

graphic.title: How an AI agent works
graphic.subtitle: and why data engineers build AI agents

shots.say: If you are new here, I am Chris. I have worked in data engineering for more than ten years.
Today I run Stackle, where I teach data and AI engineering.
A chatbot answers a question and stops.
An AI agent gets a goal, breaks the goal into steps, and uses tools like search, code, or a database to finish each step.
For example, you ask an AI agent to find last month's top product.
The agent writes a SQL query, runs the query on your database, and reads the result back to you.

graphic.title: SQL query
graphic.code:
SELECT product, SUM(sales) AS total
FROM orders
WHERE month = 'last month'
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 1;

shots.say: An AI agent is only as good as the data it can reach.
If the data is late, messy, or missing, the agent gives a wrong answer with full confidence.
Companies need engineers who build clean data pipelines and connect those pipelines safely to AI agents.
This week, pick one task you do by hand, and write down the steps an AI agent would need to do it.
If you want help planning your path into AI engineering, book a free fifteen minute call with me.
You can also join the Stackle AI Engineering masterclass.
Tell me in the comments which task you would give an AI agent first.
